first_divergence.exact_span: In order for a singularity to happen, velocity has to blow up.
first_divergence.mechanism: This is the first unearned turn. The preceding account allows derivative growth while energy stays finite, but this sentence asserts amplitude blow-up and the next paragraph treats divergence of an H^m continuation norm as its meaning. A new reader cannot tell whether velocity means pointwise amplitude, the field measured in H^m, or loss of regularity, so the causal bridge from concentration to the temporal-derivative sequence breaks here.
first_divergence.repair_constraint: Name the precise continuation quantity whose divergence is required, and earn its connection to the preceding gradient-concentration picture before moving into temporal responses. Preserve the distinction between finite energy, velocity amplitude, derivative growth, and H^m continuation failure.
